definition: The ISLRN or International Standard Language Resource Number is Persistent Unique Identifier for Language Resources..
details: The ISLRN or International Standard Language Resource Number is Persistent Unique Identifier for Language Resources.

explainer.lead: ISLRN (International Standard Language Resource Number) is a persistent unique identifier for language resources. It matters for stably identifying such resources.

tiers.eli5: Like a permanent ID number for a language dataset, so it can always be found and referred to.
tiers.practitioner: Used to give language resources a persistent unique identifier. No specific usage pattern or pitfall is given in the supplied facts.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined as a persistent unique identifier for language resources; no further formal details or limits are supplied.

explainer.example: A language resource is assigned an ISLRN so it can be referenced by a stable identifier.
